newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises further led by broader issues.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises further led by broader issues.

text.p: Czech shares continued to post solid gains on Thursday with particularly heavy upward pressure coming from the broader market.
The PX50 index rose 5.1 points, 0.9 percent, to 555.5 while the major issue dominated RPIX gained 2.0 points, 0.2 percent, to 1,148.6.

Following Wednesday's announcement by Bass that it would like to see a merger, in the medium to long term, between Prazske Pivovary, in which it holds a 51 percent stake and Radegast, in which it recently acquired 33 percent, shares in both Czech breweries moved sharply.
Radegast rose 252 crowns to 5,307 while Prazske Pivovary lost 120 crowns to 2,282.

"People are not willing to trade in Prazske Pivovary shares because of the expected merger when the situation will stabilise...but the prospects of Radegast improved significantly after news that Bass acquired 33 percent (in Radegast)," said Miroslav Nosal of Patria Finance.
Major issues were again mixed. SPT Telecom lost 17 crowns to 3,400 and Ceska Sporitelna fell one to 332. CEZ rose three crowns to 1,027 and Komercni Banka rose 14 crowns to 2,370.
